name: ASM International N.V.
guidance_fy: FY2026: Q2 2026 revenue ~EUR 980m (+/-5%); H2 2026 revenue expected higher than H1; full-year to at least outgrow the WFE market; gross margin targeted at higher end of 47-51% range; SG&A below 9% of revenue; capex around or somewhat above EUR 150-250m (Scottsdale build). notes:
PRICE: ASM trading ~EUR 1,066-1,080 around Jun 19-21, 2026 (Yahoo/Investing.com/StockAnalysis converge; 52-week range top EUR 1,080.50). Used ~EUR 1,070 as consensus. CompaniesMarketCap showed an anomalous EUR ~1,233 ATH figure that appears to be a USD-mislabel and contradicts all other sources, so disregarded. EUR/USD ~1.167 used for USD conversions; market cap ~EUR 52.1bn -> ~USD 60.8bn.

DROP CLASSIFICATION = not_depressed: stock is AT/NEAR all-time high, up ~+112% over the trailing year, only ~1% off 52-week high. Opposite of a depressed/fear situation — upcycle re-rating on AI / leading-edge logic-foundry demand and 2nm/1.4nm positioning.

VALUATION: fwd PE ~45.2 (StockAnalysis) vs ~40.5 5y avg (gurufocus/valueinvesting) => modest premium ~+12%. Other aggregators show fwd PE 39-49 depending on date/estimate basis (Yahoo 49.3; GuruFocus 39.4) — wide range; treat as ESTIMATED. PEG ~1.37.

Q1 2026: revenue EUR 862.5m (~863m), high end of EUR 830m +/-4% guidance, +16% YoY constant currency (~+7% as reported due to USD weakness), record operating margin 33.1%, gross margin 53.3%, EPS EUR 5.01 (beat ~EUR 4.02 consensus). FCF NEGATIVE EUR 48m (working-capital ramp), cash ~EUR 1bn. ASM does not split GAAP vs adjusted EPS at headline; EPS shown is reported figure.

FY2025 (VERIFIED from PR): revenue EUR 3.2bn (~3,170m), +12% constant currency (9th consecutive year double-digit growth), record gross margin 51.8%, record adjusted operating margin 30.2%, Q4 net earnings EUR 166.1m; FY net income ~EUR 724m per aggregators. Dividend EUR 3.25/share proposed (up from 3.00); new EUR 150m buyback 2026/2027 authorized. ROIC ~29% (ASM-normalized/aggregator; note GuruFocus standardized ROIC ~13.6% on stricter invested-capital basis — ESTIMATED). FCF ~EUR 979m, FCF margin ~31% (estimated).

NET CASH: total cash EUR 981.6m, total debt EUR 72m => net cash EUR 909.6m (~USD 1.06bn). net_debt_usd_b = -1.06 (negative = net cash). nd_ebitda ~ -0.83 on EBITDA ~EUR 1.09bn. net_cash=true.

ORDER INTAKE / BOOKINGS: NOT AVAILABLE for Q1 2026 — ASM formally DISCONTINUED disclosure of quarterly bookings and backlog as of Q1 2026 (FY2025 PR Update to disclosure practices); backlog now reported only at year-end. FY2025 Q4 new orders were EUR 802.8m (+19% YoY cc) for reference.
